items.title: AFCS: The Primus Epic Hardware Stack
items.description: How the AW139's Automatic Flight Control System is built up layer by layer on the Primus Epic avionics suite, followed through a real flight to show how the modes actually work together.

items.title: Electrical: Double Generator Failure Survival Logic
items.description: How the electrical system generates, converts, and distributes power, followed through a real dual DC generator failure to show exactly how the system protects itself and what the pilot does.

items.title: Fire: Suppression and Isolation Logic
items.description: How the fire detection and extinguishing system is built, followed through a real engine fire from first indication to a safe outcome.

items.title: OPC 26
items.description: Icing management and offshore command authority for the AW139, built around two real OPC practice scenarios — a day icing ferry flight and a night offshore passenger flight to a helideck under DP limits.
